---
title: "Patch supplementary figures — scatter & peak plots and DPS line"
---

## Overview

Compose supplementary scatter+peak trajectory figures for both VAE and UMAP lite pipelines. Generates multi-row panels For threshold 8 and threshold 7 at selected ranks, plus the combined DPS line plot.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, ggtext, install = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: setup-theme

source(here("custom_func/theme_main_fig.R"))
set_pub_geom_defaults()

fs::dir_create(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output"))
```

## Helper functions

### Relabel the colour key

The scatter plots carry the key "Dementia Status: Demented / Stable Normal" from `custom_func/make_faceted_scatter_and_contour_plot.R`, which codes every non-reference group "demented", including the two MCI groups. The key is relabelled here to "Group: Stable normal (reference) / Comparison group" (reviewer point R1.7), as in the main figure (01b); the colours are reused from the existing scale, so only the text changes.

```{r}
#| label: relabel-group-key

relabel_group_key <- function(plot) {
  key_colours <- plot$scales$get_scales("colour")$palette(2)
  stopifnot(setequal(names(key_colours), c("stable_normal", "demented")))
  # Replacing the existing colour scale is intended; silence ggplot's notice
  suppressMessages(
    plot +
      scale_color_manual(
        name = "Group",
        values = key_colours,
        labels = c(stable_normal = "Stable normal (reference)", demented = "Comparison group")
      )
  )
}
```

### Compose scatter+peak pairs

Stacked rows with `"AAABB"` layout (3:2 ratio). First row keeps legend; subsequent rows hide it. The `method` parameter selects the VAE or UMAP lite pipeline.

```{r}
#| label: compose-scatter-peak

compose_scatter_peak <- function(method, threshold, ranks) {
  base_path <- switch(method,
    "VAE"  = here("VAE/lite/scatter/output/fig_tbl"),
    "UMAP" = here("UMAP/lite/scatter/output/fig_tbl")
  )

  rows <- imap(ranks, \(rank, idx) {
    scatter <- read_rds(
      glue("{base_path}/threshold{threshold}/scatter_rank{rank}.rds")
    )
    peak <- read_rds(
      glue("{base_path}/threshold{threshold}/peak_rank{rank}.rds")
    )

    scatter <- relabel_group_key(scatter) + theme_main_fig() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_blank(),
        plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2, l = 2, r = 2),
        legend.position = if (idx == 1) "top" else "none"
      )
    scatter <- rescale_layer_params(scatter, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6)

    peak <- peak + theme_main_fig() +
      theme(
        plot.title = element_blank(),
        plot.subtitle = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.x = ggtext::element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 2, b = 2, l = 2, r = 2)
      )
    peak <- rescale_layer_params(peak, size_scale = 0.45, linewidth_scale = 0.45)

    scatter + peak + plot_layout(design = "AAAABB")
  })

  wrap_plots(rows, ncol = 1) +
    plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
}
```

## VAE scatter+peak plots

### VAE threshold 8 part 1 (ranks 03-05)

Main figure (01b) shows ranks 01-02 at T8, so supplementary starts at rank 03.

```{r}
#| label: suppl-fig-vae-scatter-t8-p1

fig_vae_scatter_t8_p1 <- compose_scatter_peak("VAE", 8, c("03", "04", "05"))

# ggrepel places the peak-plot labels at random (seed = NA in the shared
# custom_func/plot_density_evolution.R); a fixed seed makes the layout reproducible.
# Seed 1 was chosen by inspection (2026-10-07): in panel B of the VAE threshold-8 figure the
# normal2mci label is no longer hidden (stable_normal and normal2incid still touch, as at
# submission); the other panels are as crowded as at submission.
set.seed(1)
ggsave(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output/fig_suppl_vae_scatter_t8_part1.png"),
       fig_vae_scatter_t8_p1,
       width = 6.5, height = 4.9, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## DPS line (combined VAE and UMAP)

```{r}
#| label: suppl-fig-dps-line

fig_dps_line <- read_rds(
  here("VAE_UMAP_comb/output/fig_dps_line.rds")
)

fig_dps_line <- fig_dps_line + theme_main_fig() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    plot.subtitle = element_blank()
  )
fig_dps_line <- rescale_layer_params(fig_dps_line, size_scale = 0.6, linewidth_scale = 0.6)

ggsave(here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output/fig_suppl_dps_line.png"),
       fig_dps_line,
       width = 6.5, height = 3.9, dpi = 600, bg = "white",
       device = grDevices::png)
```

## Verify output

```{r}
#| label: verify-output

output_files <- fs::dir_ls(
  here("VAE_UMAP_comb/patch_figures/output"),
  glob = "*suppl_vae_scatter*|*suppl_umap_scatter*|*suppl_dps_line*"
)
fs::file_info(output_files) |>
  select(path, size, modification_time) |>
  mutate(path = basename(path))
```
